title: Accessibility and responsiveness as the floor, not the finish

videos.script: Accessibility is often treated as a finishing touch, something to add if there is time. It is the opposite. It is the floor: the level below which a page does not work for some of the people who try to use it. {{floor}} A teacher who uses a screen reader, one who only has a keyboard, one reading on a phone in a corridor. For each of them, a page is either usable or it is not, and no amount of polish elsewhere changes which. {{who}} This lesson checks loanbook's page before and after its accessibility commit, with a tool and with a keyboard. The tool finds some things. The keyboard finds the one the tool missed.
